description: Check brand voice consistency across samples. Give `samples` (a list, or text with samples separated by a line of ---, or by blank lines; 2 to 40) and optionally `rules` (plain lines or JSON: banned words, 'use X not Y', capitalisation of names, punctuation bans, max sentence length, required terms) and `bannedWords`. Returns per-sample sentence length (mean, spread, longest), contractions, you/we use, a 0 to 100 formality score from transparent measures, drift flags where a sample is 15+ formality points or 35% in sentence length from the set, rule violations by sample, and required terms that never appear. Heuristic, English only; it compares samples with each other, not with a standard.

rules.description: Voice rules: lines of text, or a JSON object/array

samples.description: The pieces of copy to compare (2 to 40)

name: brand_voice_consistency
title: Voice consistency
